verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs describe embeddable checkout elements — the PayPal Smart Button rendered directly on the merchant's site (paypal-docs-2/37) and 'Expanded Checkout' with 'card field customization with your business branding' (paypal-docs-27) plus Braintree's GraphQL API for building custom payment/vault flows (paypal-supp-braintree-graphql) — supporting in-page, brandable checkout rather than a pure hosted-page redirect. However, the evidence doesn't detail the actual component customization API (styling options, hosted/advanced card fields specifics) or provide hands-on/independent confirmation that the experience avoids redirects end-to-end. Missing for 10: detailed docs/code for Advanced/Hosted Card Fields customization, explicit no-redirect UX confirmation, and independent developer corroboration of embedding experience.
